groups.invis: background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.0); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.0); border: none; padding: 0px; border-radius: 0px;
groups.label: background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.0); color: #ffffff; font-weight: bold; border: none; padding: 0px; border-radius: 0px;
groups.tooltip: background-color: rgba(35, 35, 35, 0.9); color: #ffffff; font-weight: bold; border: 1px solid #555555; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px;
groups.widget: background-color: rgba(50, 50, 50, 0.8); color: #ffffff; font-weight: bold; border: 1px solid #777777; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px;
groups.widget:hover: background-color: #ffffff; color: #000000; font-weight: bold; border: 3px solid #000000; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px;
groups.group: background-color: rgba(25, 25, 25, 0.8); color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #777777; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px;
groups.group:hover: background-color: rgba(255, 173, 236, 0.5); color: #000000; font-weight: bold; border: 3px solid #000000; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px;
groups.block_label: color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1.0); font-weight: bold; border: none; padding: 0px; border-radius: 0px;
groups.block: background-color: rgba(100, 100, 100, 0.9); font-weight: bold; border: 1px solid rgba(150, 150, 150, 1.0); padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px;
